name: Mary the Innkeeper
description: A kind-faced woman who runs the Weary Traveler Inn.

dialogue.greeting: Welcome to the Weary Traveler! Can I get you something?
dialogue.cannotBuy: I'm afraid I can't take that off your hands.

name: Joe the General Merchant
description: A portly man with a bushy mustache who sells a bit of everything.

dialogue.greeting: Welcome, welcome! Take a look around!
dialogue.cannotBuy: Sorry, I don't deal in those kinds of goods.

name: Grom the Blacksmith
description: A muscular man covered in soot, with arms like tree trunks.

dialogue.greeting: Need something forged? Or perhaps you've got metal to sell?
dialogue.cannotBuy: That's not my trade. Try the general store.

name: Priestess Elena
description: A serene woman in white robes who tends the Temple of Light.

dialogue.greeting: May the light guide you. How may I be of service?
dialogue.cannotBuy: The temple cannot accept such... tainted offerings.

name: Morrigan the Witch
description: A mysterious woman with dark hair and knowing eyes.

dialogue.greeting: Ah, a visitor... How delightful. What brings you to my humble abode?
dialogue.cannotBuy: That holds no interest for me. Bring me something... darker.
dialogue.farewell: Do come again... if you dare.

name: Zephyr the Wanderer
description: A cloaked figure with a cart full of exotic goods.

dialogue.greeting: Greetings, traveler! I have wares from distant lands...
dialogue.cannotBuy: Common goods? I seek only the extraordinary.

name: The Whisper
description: A hooded figure who deals in... questionable goods.

dialogue.greeting: You didn't see me, and I didn't see you. What do you need?
dialogue.cannotBuy: I don't deal in that. Too clean for my taste.
